name: Chipping Sparrow
facts: Chipping Sparrows are common in open woods and suburban yards, often seen feeding on the ground in loose flocks.
Their song is a dry, rapid trill that can seem constant in late spring and summer.
They often nest in conifers, choosing evergreen branches that provide shelter and camouflaged cover.
